description_for_model: Run MCP servers and AI workloads in a sandbox you control. Inspect what a Warden policy allows and denies (filesystem, network, environment), execute a workload through the Warden sandbox under an explicit deny-by-default policy, trace what a sandboxed execution attempted, and explain why Warden blocked an access. Warden is enforcement, not advice: every allow/deny result comes from the real Warden runtime, and anything a policy does not explicitly grant is denied. Use inspect_policy and trace_execution for read-only inspection; run_sandbox executes the given command sandboxed and requires an explicit policy path; generate_policy only proposes YAML and never applies it. Never bypass the sandbox, never infer that an unlisted permission is granted, and never claim Warden guarantees complete security.
description_for_human: Run AI and MCP workloads in a sandbox you control. Warden enforces deny-by-default filesystem, network, and environment permissions and shows you exactly what happened.

tools.name: inspect_policy
tools.description: Inspect what a Warden policy allows and denies (read-only)

tools.name: run_sandbox
tools.description: Execute a command inside the Warden sandbox under an explicit policy (mutating: runs the command)

tools.name: trace_execution
tools.description: Summarize what a sandboxed execution attempted (read-only)

tools.name: explain_denial
tools.description: Explain why Warden blocked an access (read-only; never grants permission)

tools.name: generate_policy
tools.description: Propose a restrictive Warden policy from explicit requirements (proposal only; never applied)
